title: 3. Article (A, An, The) & Jenis Noun
group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: Area dengan kesalahan terbanyak bagi penutur bahasa Bangla. Countable vs uncountable noun, tiga article ditambah zero article, proses keputusan empat langkah untuk proofreading, dan kasus-kasus tetap.

Kalau Anda hanya memperbaiki satu bab di seluruh buku ini, perbaikilah bab ini. Article adalah area dengan kesalahan terbanyak bagi pelajar yang bahasa pertamanya tidak punya article, dan bahasa Bangla, Hindi, Urdu, serta Nepali semuanya tidak punya padanan langsung untuk a / an / the. Ini bukan detail kecil. Kesalahan article adalah alasan nomor satu mengapa kandidat yang sebenarnya kuat di level Band 7 tetap terjebak di Band 6.0, karena kesalahannya sering, muncul di hampir setiap kalimat, dan telinga Anda tidak bisa menangkapnya: bahasa pertama Anda tidak pernah melatihnya.
Boleh tidaknya Anda memakai a / an bergantung pada perbedaan ini, jadi pelajari dulu sebelum aturan article.
Countable noun bisa dihitung dan punya bentuk plural: one book, two books; a student, five students. Dalam bentuk singular, noun ini bisa memakai a / an.
Uncountable noun dianggap sebagai satu massa dan tidak punya bentuk plural maupun a / an: information (tidak pernah informations), water, advice.

Uncountable noun yang sering muncul dan sering menjebak kandidat Bangladesh, layak dihafal sebagai satu kelompok: information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, water, work, luggage, baggage, software, staff, homework, feedback, transport, machinery, vocabulary.
Untuk menghitung uncountable noun, pakai partitive phrase (kata satuan) ditambah of:
a study / a piece of research
a piece of furniture / an item of furniture

Ada tiga article (a, an, the) dan pilihan keempat, yaitu tanpa article sama sekali, yang disebut zero article. Setiap singular countable noun membutuhkan salah satu dari empat pilihan ini, yang dipilih dengan sengaja.

Pakai a / an untuk satu benda countable yang singular dan tidak spesifik, biasanya disebut untuk pertama kali. Pilihan antara a dan an bergantung pada bunyi, bukan ejaan. Pakai an sebelum bunyi vokal, a sebelum bunyi konsonan.
a university, a European country (keduanya dimulai dengan bunyi konsonan “y”)
an hour, an honest man (h tidak dibunyikan, jadi bunyinya vokal)
an MBA, an X-ray (nama huruf yang dimulai dengan bunyi vokal)
I saw a documentary last night. (penyebutan pertama, tidak spesifik) / She wants to become an engineer. (satu, tidak spesifik)
Pakai the kalau noun-nya spesifik: pembaca atau pendengar tahu persis yang mana yang Anda maksud. Hal ini terjadi dengan beberapa cara:
Sudah disebutkan sebelumnya: I saw a documentary. The documentary was about climate change.
Hanya ada satu: the sun, the government, the internet, the environment.
Dibuat spesifik oleh kata-kata di sekitarnya: the number of cars, the graph above, the capital of Bangladesh.
Dengan superlative dan ordinal: the highest figure, the most important factor, the first step.
The chart shows the number of visitors. (keduanya spesifik) / Solar power is the cleanest option available. (superlative)
Plural countable noun yang dibicarakan secara umum: Books are expensive. Cars cause pollution.
Uncountable noun yang dibicarakan secara umum: Water is essential. Education matters. Poverty is rising.
Sebagian besar proper noun: nama sebagian besar negara, kota, orang, bahasa: Bangladesh, Dhaka, English.
Education is a basic right. (uncountable umum, zero article) / Cars contribute to pollution. (plural umum + uncountable umum)
3.3 Proses keputusan (pakai ini saat Anda proofreading)
Saat Anda mengecek singular noun apa pun, jawab pertanyaan-pertanyaan ini secara berurutan:
Apakah noun ini countable? Kalau tidak (uncountable), Anda tidak bisa memakai a / an. Pilih the (kalau spesifik) atau zero article (kalau umum). Selesai.
Kalau ya (countable): apakah spesifik, sudah diketahui, atau hanya ada satu? Kalau ya, pakai the.
Kalau tidak spesifik dan singular: pakai a / an (berdasarkan bunyi).
Kalau plural umum: pakai zero article.
Beberapa pilihan article memang sudah tetap dan sebaiknya dihafal:
the internet, the environment, the economy, the government, the media, the public, the world memakai the (dianggap hanya ada satu).
Superlative selalu memakai the: the best, the largest, the most significant.

Institusi yang dipakai sesuai fungsinya memakai zero article: go to school, go to university, go to hospital (pemakaian British), in prison, at home. Tambahkan the hanya kalau yang Anda maksud adalah gedungnya secara spesifik.

Negara: sebagian besar memakai zero article (Bangladesh, France, China), tetapi beberapa nama yang plural atau mengandung “united/republic” memakai the: the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, the Philippines.

Penyebutan pertama lalu penyebutan kedua: perkenalkan dengan a, rujuk kembali dengan the. Inilah perpindahan klasik dari a ke the yang dicari examiner: The chart shows a sharp rise in 2018. The rise continued into 2019.
Mengapa penutur bahasa Bangla salah memakai article

Karena bahasa Bangla sama sekali tidak punya article, kategori ini tidak ada dalam grammar di kepala Anda, jadi harus dipelajari sebagai sistem khusus bahasa Inggris, bukan diterjemahkan. Ada tiga pola kesalahan yang dominan.

Error type 1 · Menghilangkan “the” untuk hal yang spesifik dan hanya ada satu.
✗ Internet has changed our lives. / Government should fund school.
✓ The internet has changed our lives. / The government should fund schools.

Error type 2 · Memakai “a / an” dengan uncountable noun. Inilah kesalahan “an advice / an information”.
✗ He gave me an advice. / She did a research on it.
✓ He gave me some advice / a piece of advice. / She did research / a study on it.

Error type 3 · Menghilangkan article sama sekali sebelum singular countable noun.
✗ Government should take step to reduce pollution.
✓ The government should take steps to reduce pollution.

Penguasaan article diperiksa secara ketat di setiap task. Di Task 1, satu kalimat saja bisa menuntut tiga keputusan article yang berbeda: “The chart shows the number of visitors to a museum.” Dalam generalisasi Task 2, polanya berubah menjadi zero article dan the: “Governments should protect the environment.” Karena kesalahannya sangat sering, inilah hal klasik yang membedakan tulisan yang idenya terbaca seperti Band 7 tetapi mendapat Band 6 di Grammatical Range and Accuracy.

Skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: The graph illustrates the proportion of households with an internet connection.
Task 2: Education is widely seen as the key to development, and governments should therefore fund schools properly.
Speaking Part 2: The person who influenced me most was a teacher at my primary school.
Akhir Bab 3. Berikutnya Bab 4 (Preposition & Aturan Ketergantungan).

title: 3. Practice · Article (A, An, The) & Jenis Noun
group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: Setiap singular countable noun membutuhkan pilihan yang disengaja: a/an, the, atau tanpa article sama sekali. Aturannya bergantung pada satu pertanyaan -- apakah noun ini spesifik bagi penulis dan pembaca, atau tidak?

**Mengapa ini penting:** Kesalahan article termasuk kesalahan yang paling sering -- dan paling terlihat -- dalam tulisan kandidat Bangladesh, karena bahasa Bangla sama sekali tidak punya sistem article.

**a/an** -- satu benda countable yang singular dan tidak spesifik, biasanya penyebutan pertama. Pilihannya bergantung pada **bunyi, bukan ejaan**: a university (bunyi konsonan), an hour (h tidak dibunyikan, bunyi vokal).
**the** -- noun-nya spesifik: sudah disebutkan, hanya ada satu (the sun, the government), atau dibuat spesifik oleh kata-kata di sekitarnya (the number of cars).
**zero article** -- plural dan uncountable yang dipakai dalam arti umum, serta sebagian besar proper noun.

Tanyakan: apakah ini sudah disebutkan sebelumnya, atau apakah hanya ada satu? Kalau ya, pakai the. Kalau ini satu contoh yang tidak spesifik, pakai a/an. Kalau keduanya tidak berlaku, jangan pakai article sama sekali.

blocks.title: Exercise 3.1 · Menyisipkan Article
blocks.instructions: Article-nya sudah dihapus. Tulis ulang setiap kalimat dengan menyisipkan a, an, atau the di tempat yang perlu. Beberapa tempat kosong membutuhkan zero article (tanpa kata).

items.prompt: ___ education is ___ key to ___ economic development.
items.answer: Education is the key to economic development.
accepted: Education is the key to economic development.
items.reason: “education” dan “development” sebagai uncountable umum memakai zero article; “the key” spesifik.

items.prompt: She is ___ most hard-working student in ___ class.
items.answer: She is the most hard-working student in the class.
accepted: She is the most hard-working student in the class.
items.reason: Superlative dan kelas yang spesifik sama-sama memakai “the.”

items.prompt: ___ chart shows ___ number of tourists visiting ___ museum.
items.answer: The chart shows the number of tourists visiting a museum.
accepted: The chart shows the number of tourists visiting a museum.
items.reason: “the chart,” “the number of,” penyebutan pertama “a museum.”

items.prompt: ___ internet has transformed ___ way people communicate.
items.answer: The internet has transformed the way people communicate.
accepted: The internet has transformed the way people communicate.
items.reason: “the internet” hanya ada satu; “the way” dibuat spesifik oleh clause sesudahnya.

items.prompt: He wants to become ___ honest lawyer after ___ university.
items.answer: He wants to become an honest lawyer after university.
accepted: He wants to become an honest lawyer after university.
items.reason: “an” sebelum bunyi vokal “honest” (h tidak dibunyikan); “university” sebagai institusi memakai zero article.

items.prompt: ___ pollution is ___ serious problem in ___ major cities.
items.answer: Pollution is a serious problem in major cities.
accepted: Pollution is a serious problem in major cities.
items.reason: “pollution” uncountable umum; “a problem” penyebutan pertama; “cities” plural umum.

items.prompt: I read ___ interesting article yesterday. ___ article was about ___ climate change.
items.answer: I read an interesting article yesterday. The article was about climate change.
accepted: I read an interesting article yesterday. The article was about climate change.
items.reason: Penyebutan pertama “an,” penyebutan kedua “the,” “climate change” umum.

items.prompt: ___ government should invest more in ___ public transport.
items.answer: The government should invest more in public transport.
accepted: The government should invest more in public transport.

items.prompt: ___ United States and ___ United Kingdom signed ___ agreement.
items.answer: The United States and the United Kingdom signed an agreement.
accepted: The United States and the United Kingdom signed an agreement.
items.reason: Nama negara ini memakai “the”; “an agreement” penyebutan pertama.

items.prompt: ___ sun rises in ___ east.
items.answer: The sun rises in the east.
accepted: The sun rises in the east.

items.prompt: ___ poverty remains ___ obstacle to ___ progress in ___ developing world.
items.answer: Poverty remains an obstacle to progress in the developing world.
accepted: Poverty remains an obstacle to progress in the developing world.
items.reason: “poverty” dan “progress” umum; “an obstacle” penyebutan pertama; “the developing world” spesifik.

items.prompt: She gave me ___ useful advice about ___ visa process.
items.answer: She gave me useful advice about the visa process.
accepted: She gave me useful advice about the visa process.

items.prompt: ___ number of ___ students who fail ___ exam is rising.
items.answer: The number of students who fail the exam is rising.
accepted: The number of students who fail the exam is rising.

items.prompt: My brother is ___ engineer, and he works for ___ large company.
items.answer: My brother is an engineer, and he works for a large company.
accepted: My brother is an engineer, and he works for a large company.

items.prompt: ___ water is essential for ___ life on ___ Earth.
items.answer: Water is essential for life on Earth.
accepted: Water is essential for life on Earth.
items.reason: Uncountable umum dan proper noun “Earth” memakai zero article.

items.prompt: We stayed in ___ hotel near ___ airport; ___ hotel was cheap.
items.answer: We stayed in a hotel near the airport; the hotel was cheap.
accepted: We stayed in a hotel near the airport; the hotel was cheap.
items.reason: Penyebutan pertama “a hotel,” “the airport” yang sudah diketahui, penyebutan kedua “the hotel.”

items.prompt: ___ research shows that ___ exercise improves ___ mental health.
items.answer: Research shows that exercise improves mental health.
accepted: Research shows that exercise improves mental health.

items.prompt: ___ environment must be protected for ___ future generations.
items.answer: The environment must be protected for future generations.
accepted: The environment must be protected for future generations.
items.reason: “the environment” hanya ada satu; “future generations” plural umum.

items.prompt: He spent ___ hour reading ___ book about ___ history of ___ Bangladesh.
items.answer: He spent an hour reading a book about the history of Bangladesh.
accepted: He spent an hour reading a book about the history of Bangladesh.
items.reason: “an hour” (h tidak dibunyikan), “a book” penyebutan pertama, “the history of X” spesifik, proper noun “Bangladesh” zero article.

items.prompt: ___ traffic in ___ capital is ___ major source of ___ air pollution.
items.answer: The traffic in the capital is a major source of air pollution.
accepted: The traffic in the capital is a major source of air pollution.
items.reason: “the traffic” spesifik, “the capital” spesifik, “a source” penyebutan pertama, “air pollution” umum.

items.prompt: ___ knowledge is power, but ___ information alone is not ___ knowledge.
items.answer: Knowledge is power, but information alone is not knowledge.
accepted: Knowledge is power, but information alone is not knowledge.

items.prompt: She is ___ best doctor in ___ hospital where I work.
items.answer: She is the best doctor in the hospital where I work.
accepted: She is the best doctor in the hospital where I work.
items.reason: Superlative dan rumah sakit yang spesifik.

items.prompt: ___ children in ___ rural areas often lack access to ___ good schools.
items.answer: Children in rural areas often lack access to good schools.
accepted: Children in rural areas often lack access to good schools.

items.prompt: ___ economy grew by ___ five per cent in ___ first quarter.
items.answer: The economy grew by five per cent in the first quarter.
accepted: The economy grew by five per cent in the first quarter.
items.reason: “the economy” hanya ada satu, “five per cent” tanpa article, “the first quarter” ordinal.

items.prompt: ___ solar power is ___ cleaner alternative to ___ fossil fuels.
items.answer: Solar power is a cleaner alternative to fossil fuels.
accepted: Solar power is a cleaner alternative to fossil fuels.
items.reason: “solar power” uncountable umum, “a cleaner alternative” penyebutan pertama, “fossil fuels” plural umum.

blocks: Bisa tidaknya a/an dipakai bergantung lebih dulu pada satu perbedaan: apakah noun ini bisa dihitung? Uncountable noun seperti information dan advice tidak pernah diberi -s plural dan tidak pernah memakai a/an secara langsung.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Perbedaan ini menentukan apakah aturan article dan plural berlaku atau tidak, jadi harus didahulukan sebelum semua hal lain di Bab 3.
**Countable noun** bisa dihitung dan punya bentuk plural: one book, two books. Dalam bentuk singular memakai a/an.
**Uncountable noun** adalah satu massa, **tanpa bentuk plural** dan **tanpa a/an**: information (tidak pernah informations), water, advice.
Kelompok kata IELTS yang sering muncul untuk dihafal
information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, work, luggage, software, staff, homework.
Pakai **partitive phrase**: bukan an advice tetapi a piece of advice; bukan a furniture tetapi a piece of furniture atau an item of furniture.

blocks.title: Exercise 3.2 · Menemukan Kesalahan Countable versus Uncountable
blocks.instructions: Setiap kalimat salah memakai sebuah noun, biasanya dengan memberi uncountable noun -s plural atau a / an. Tulis ulang setiap kalimat dengan benar.

items.prompt: The teacher gave us many useful advices before the exam.
items.answer: The teacher gave us much useful advice before the exam.
accepted: The teacher gave us much useful advice before the exam.

items.prompt: I need some informations about the application process.
items.answer: I need some information about the application process.
accepted: I need some information about the application process.

items.prompt: She bought new furnitures for her apartment.
items.answer: She bought new furniture for her apartment.
accepted: She bought new furniture for her apartment.
items.reason: “furniture” tidak punya plural; pakai “pieces of furniture” kalau menghitung.

items.prompt: The laboratory does not have enough equipments.
items.answer: The laboratory does not have enough equipment.
accepted: The laboratory does not have enough equipment.

items.prompt: He has made a good progress in his studies this year.
items.answer: He has made good progress in his studies this year.
accepted: He has made good progress in his studies this year.

items.prompt: The researchers published several important researches last year.
items.answer: The researchers published several important studies last year.
accepted: The researchers published several important studies last year.

items.prompt: We had a lot of homeworks during the holidays.
items.answer: We had a lot of homework during the holidays.
accepted: We had a lot of homework during the holidays.

items.prompt: The company installed new softwares on every computer.
items.answer: The company installed new software on every computer.
accepted: The company installed new software on every computer.

items.prompt: There were many traffics on the road this morning.
items.answer: There was heavy traffic on the road this morning.
accepted: There was heavy traffic on the road this morning.

items.prompt: The hotel provides free accommodations for its staffs.
items.answer: The hotel provides free accommodation for its staff.
accepted: The hotel provides free accommodation for its staff.

items.prompt: My knowledges of physics are quite limited.
items.answer: My knowledge of physics is quite limited.
accepted: My knowledge of physics is quite limited.

items.prompt: The government spent a huge money on the project.
items.answer: The government spent a huge amount of money on the project.
accepted: The government spent a huge amount of money on the project.

items.prompt: She gave me two good news yesterday.
items.answer: She gave me some good news yesterday.
accepted: She gave me some good news yesterday.
She gave me two pieces of good news yesterday.

items.prompt: The students carried heavy luggages to the airport.
items.answer: The students carried heavy luggage to the airport.
accepted: The students carried heavy luggage to the airport.

items.prompt: The report contains many useful datas about the economy.
items.answer: The report contains much useful data about the economy.
accepted: The report contains much useful data about the economy.
items.reason: “data” di sini dianggap uncountable/mass noun; “datas” tidak pernah benar.
